records.title: XRPL native lending amendment status and loan-broker board activation requirements
records.summary: At ledger 108009204 (21:12 UTC), the dashboard states that three amendments are in validator voting: LendingProtocol (XLS-66), SingleAssetVault (XLS-65) and LendingProtocolV1_1 (closed-ended vaults and cash-basis accounting). It explains that LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault are the core requirements for native lending, while the loan-broker board waits for LendingProtocol + SingleAssetVault + LendingProtocolV1_1. The board was still awaiting activation. The dashboard says its data comes from a live feature RPC via its own xrpld node.
records.limitations: Secondary live-node dashboard; V1_1 vote count was not retrieved. XRPLWin direct page for V1_1 was inaccessible. This corrects the earlier incomplete two-amendment summary without changing the fact that native lending is not live.
